_comment_allow: ALLOW: actions that are read-only or trivially reversible. Even if the agent picks the wrong moment to run these, nothing is lost - low blast radius means no gate needed.

permissions._comment_ask: ASK: actions that are reversible but visible to others, cost money, or touch shared state. A human should be in the loop once per occurrence, not blocked forever - medium blast radius.
permissions._comment_deny: DENY: actions that are irreversible, leak secrets, or affect systems outside this project entirely. No prompt is worth the risk - high blast radius means the rule fires with no exception, every time.
